commit.message: docs(repo-hygiene): audit lost work and execute conservative cleanup

invariants: Do not delete dirty worktrees or stashes.
Do not delete remote branches in this packet.
Do not open recovery PRs without file-level verification of candidate work.
Use origin/main as graph authority for local cleanup safety.
Preserve local recovery artifacts before cleanup commands.
Keep repo runtime, service, schema, API, and production config behavior unchanged.
Record every cleanup command with exit code and output.

pr.body:
## Summary
- audit local worktrees, branches, reflogs, PR heads, and stashes for work not in main
- preserve dirty/stash content under a local recovery root before cleanup
- prune stale worktree metadata, remove one clean duplicate worktree, and delete only graph-proven local merged branches

## Validation
- packet and proof JSON validate
- cleanup commands recorded with exit codes
- git diff whitespace check run
- dopemux-pr-merge self-check run

## Follow-up
Content-audit and stash-recovery items need file-level review before topic recovery PRs.
pr.title: docs(repo-hygiene): audit lost work and execute conservative cleanup

requirements: Confirm origin/main base, remotes, worktree root, open PR state, worktree inventory, branch inventory, stash inventory, and reflog evidence.
steps.task: Refresh repo identity and current Git/GitHub authority from a clean dedicated worktree.
validation: Authority outputs are captured under the local recovery root and summarized in proof.

requirements: Write binary patches, untracked-file archives, branch diffs/bundles where applicable, stash patches, and a local machine-readable ledger.
steps.task: Preserve dirty worktree, branch, and stash content outside the repo before cleanup.
validation: Recovery root exists and proof references it.

requirements: Use graph proof, patch equivalence, dirty state, and attachment state; do not classify unknown or dirty items as delete-safe.
steps.task: Classify every worktree, branch, and stash into deterministic cleanup/recovery classes.
validation: Proof lists worktrees, branches, stashes, and topic recovery candidates with class and reason.

requirements: Prune missing worktree metadata, remove only clean duplicate worktrees, delete only local branches fully merged by graph proof, and preserve the original thread checkout.
steps.task: Execute only conservative local cleanup actions and record exact outputs.
validation: Cleanup result JSON records every command and no failures.

requirements: Commit only the allowlisted docs/proof/task-packet files; do not commit local recovery artifacts.
steps.task: Publish packet, audit report, proof, and index update.
validation: JSON validation and whitespace validation pass.

target: Audit all worktrees, branches, reflogs, PR heads, and stashes for unique work not in main; preserve dirty/stash content first; execute only conservative local cleanup; publish proof for follow-up topic recovery PRs.
